apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged once per run (Apify synthetic start event; priced per GB of run memory, 1 GB minimum). Target ~$0.001 for a typical 512 MB–1 GB start.

image-converted.eventDescription: Charged once per image successfully compressed/converted and stored in the key-value store with a metadata dataset row. Failed/non-image/oversized/duplicate rows are free unless chargeFailedImages is enabled.

image-strip-only.eventDescription: Optional cheaper event when stripOnly is enabled: metadata (EXIF/GPS) stripped and re-saved without pixel re-encode. Only charged for successful strip-only stores.
